quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report: revenue RMB 6,467,563,008.98 (RMB 64.68 hundred million), down 28.04% year over year because gold and platinum scrap recovery moved to toll refining with in-kind exchange and is no longer booked as revenue; excluding precious-metal scrap, revenue grew 8.97%. The company raised prices of some LED chips, RF chips, power-electronics chips and optical chips to offset higher precious-metal and substrate prices. Net profit attributable to shareholders RMB -97,904,534.71 (down 155.47%); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB -504,220,859.63 (down 402.47%); operating cash flow RMB 721,922,624.85 (down 23.56%). By business: LED epitaxial wafers and chips RMB 31.03 hundred million (up 11.81%), integrated-circuit products RMB 12.68 hundred million (down 15.40%), LED application products RMB 16.83 hundred million (up 17.62%).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue RMB 64.68 hundred million (-28.04%; +8.97% excl. precious-metal scrap); net profit RMB -97,904,534.71 (-155.47%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 profitability by business: the LED business was profitable and the integrated-circuit business lost money, mainly because filter and SiC line utilization was low, the product-mix improvement was not complete and depreciation and fixed amortization were high; the optical business improved markedly and turned profitable in Q2 2026. Xiamen Sanan Integrated Circuit (RF) revenue RMB 9.50 hundred million, net profit RMB 0.61 hundred million; Hunan Sanan (power electronics) revenue RMB 3.56 hundred million, net profit RMB -2.08 hundred million. The company will raise the share of high-end LED products and accelerate SiC, filter and optical expansion to raise utilization, sales and profitability.
quarterly_data.figure: RF subsidiary revenue RMB 9.50 hundred million, net profit RMB 0.61 hundred million; Hunan Sanan revenue RMB 3.56 hundred million, net profit RMB -2.08 hundred million; optical profitable in Q2 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Power electronics (H1 2026 half-year report): Hunan Sanan now offers SiC diodes from 650V to 2000V and industrial and automotive SiC MOSFETs of 650V/1200V/1400V/1700V/2300V (20 to 1000 milliohm). SiC MOSFET shipments for on-board chargers (including DCDC) and air-conditioning compressors grew sharply, PV and storage deliveries are in stable volume, and in data centers SiC MOSFETs have reached small-batch delivery to system customers; overall MOSFET utilization keeps rising. SiC diodes are in volume delivery to PV and storage customers Sungrow, Sigenergy, GoodWe, Ginlong, Growatt, Sineng, Aiswei and Deye and to white-goods customers Midea, Gree, TCL and Haier. GaN-on-silicon 650V and 100V unidirectional switches have entered system validation for AI server power supplies and humanoid-robot joint actuators, and 650V bidirectional GaN switch samples have been developed.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: RF front end (H1 2026 half-year report): GaN RF renewed long-term orders with a major domestic customer and achieved an overseas breakthrough, starting volume supply to an Asia-Pacific international telecom equipment company; the ultra-thin buffer epitaxy process reached mass production. GaAs RF foundry capacity is 1.8 ten-thousand wafers a month and development of the next-generation HP6 process has started. Filter capacity is 150KK a month; a high-performance small GPS filter entered customers' flagship models and wafer-level-packaged (WLP) filters are in volume supply on a strategic customer's flagship models.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical (H1 2026 half-year report): optical revenue grew substantially; 2.5G PON, 10G PON and FTTR chips entered the supplier pools of leading domestic and overseas equipment makers with shipments up sharply, and 50G PON chips are sampling; wide-temperature automotive VCSEL and PD chips are in volume shipment; 940 VCSELs entered the supply chain of a leading domestic phone brand with shipments up sharply.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: LED (H1 2026 half-year report): GaAs multi-junction solar cell orders kept growing and H1 2026 shipments already exceeded 70% of full-year 2025; an improved flexible solar-cell process was developed for low-earth-orbit satellites. Micro LED for optical interconnect has gone through several rounds of validation with several domestic and overseas customers, and a line with semiconductor-grade advanced processes is being built for consumer Micro LED products. Automotive lamp subsidiary Anrui won 13 new domestic project nominations and new European projects from Aston Martin, McLaren and Togg.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 solar-cell shipments over 70% of full-year 2025; Anrui 13 new nominations

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Major projects at June 30, 2026: Hunan Sanan SiC semiconductor project cumulative investment RMB 211.63 hundred million (132.27% of its RMB 160.00 hundred million budget; RMB 7.26 hundred million in H1); Hubei Sanan Mini/Micro display project cumulative RMB 44.60 hundred million (37.17% of RMB 120.00 hundred million; RMB 13.13 hundred million in H1), chip capacity 15 ten-thousand wafers a month and special packaging 1,000KK a month, H1 revenue RMB 3.32 hundred million and net profit RMB 0.77 hundred million; the board extended the Hubei project's ready-for-use date to June 2028. Chongqing SiC substrate project cumulative RMB 11.59 hundred million (16.56% of RMB 70.00 hundred million); Chongqing Sanan H1 revenue RMB 0.23 hundred million and net profit RMB 0.08 hundred million.
quarterly_data.figure: Hubei Mini/Micro project ready date extended to June 2028; Hunan SiC cumulative RMB 211.63 hundred million; Chongqing RMB 11.59 hundred million
